sentences.japanese: 旅館は、上げ膳据え膳がうれしいね。
sentences.english: At a Japanese-style inn, they take care of your every need, so you don't have to lift a finger.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は膳の上のものを酔った手つきで掴み散らしました。
sentences.english: She threw away everything that was on the small dining table in a drunken hand gesture.
